statement: ∀ a : ℝ, 1 < a → Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ENNReal.ofReal ((N : ℝ) ^ (1-a))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, 0 < N ∧ 1 / (N : ℝ) ≤ δ
proof:
intro a ha
constructor
· have h : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (N : ℝ) ^ (1-a)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, neg_sub] using (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (sub_pos.mpr ha)).comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  simpa using ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal h
· intro δ hδ
  have h : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => 1 / (N : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, one_div] using tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ))
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0, h.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ)] with N hN hNd
  exact ⟨hN, hNd.le⟩
